His disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat. But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of. Jn. 4:31-32 Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God. Lk. 14:15 Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. Jn. 21:12
